description: Redesign the share page (backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js) as a premium mobile-first responsive landing page. Fix all mobile issues: horizontal scrolling, oversized video/images, hidden CTA, layout overflow. Ensure it works on iPhone Safari, Android Chrome, Tablet, and Desktop.
steps: Rewrite the CSS in the GET /p/:postId route HTML template in backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js to be mobile-first responsive with these fixes: (1) Add max-width:100vw and overflow-x:hidden on html,body to prevent horizontal scroll. (2) Constrain artwork-preview/video to max-height:50vh on mobile so the CTA is always visible below. (3) Use width:100% with object-fit:cover/contain and proper aspect-ratio constraints for images/video. (4) Ensure the CTA section (Open App button, store buttons) is always visible without scrolling past the fold on mobile - consider using a sticky/fixed bottom CTA bar on small screens. (5) Make gallery items responsive with max-height constraints. (6) Add responsive breakpoints: mobile-first default, then tablet (min-width: 768px), desktop (min-width: 1024px). (7) Improve the overall visual design: subtle gradients, better spacing, glass-morphism effects for a premium feel. (8) Ensure the Coming Soon section is visible without excessive scrolling.
Also update the user profile share page (/u/:username) and the buildGenericPage() function with the same mobile-first responsive approach and premium styling.
Ensure all viewport meta tags are present (width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover) and add -webkit-text-size-adjust:100% to prevent text scaling issues on iOS.
Validate the file parses correctly with node --check
acceptance_criteria: No horizontal scroll on any viewport width (overflow-x: hidden on body/html)
Video/image content constrained to max 50vh on mobile so CTA is visible below
CTA (Open App) button is always visible without scrolling or via sticky bottom bar on mobile
Premium modern visual design with gradients, proper spacing, and typography
verification: Visual inspection of the HTML/CSS structure confirms mobile-first design patterns
findings: Successfully redesigned all three page templates (post share, user profile, generic page). node --check validation passes. Note: NODE_OPTIONS must be unset in this sandbox for node --check to work due to a missing preload module. The sticky CTA bar uses position:fixed with backdrop-filter blur and is hidden via display:none in tablet/desktop media queries.
